mechanism.base: Earth on earth is ground laid over ground. Soil settles onto soil, season after season, until the layers forget where one ended and the next began. Nothing arrives from outside, so the field thickens by its own weight, keeps what falls on it and gives it back slowly if at all. What grows there grows out of depth, and it stands long after faster things have fallen.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Earth, the ground under you is shallow, and every load goes straight through to your knees. Nothing stays put without a push from outside. Sleep and eat before you decide anything.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Earth, the ground packs down on itself until nothing moves across it and nothing new comes up. Every opinion settles into bedrock. Say yes to one deadline you did not set.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Earth gives it weight and patience under a load. Running thin, your strength has less in reserve and holds back until something real is on the line. Once it is, you give it everything.
function.definition_friction: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Earth sets you solid and slow to shift. Running over, your strength has nowhere to go and it sets into a fixed stance. You give up closeness to keep your place.
function.definition_balanced: Your Body is the strength the whole of you stands on. Earth gives it weight and patience under a load. In balance, your strength carries what is yours at an even pace. Your effort and your recovery keep step with each other.
function.advise_catalyst: Most of what you give up, you give up tired. Wait for the whole answer before you agree to anything. Keep one routine that survives a bad month. Tend one pot of herbs from spring to autumn.
function.advise_friction: Seek Wood, the Order energy. Wood pushes up through packed soil and reaches for a height it has to earn. Let it shape what Earth stores. You hold your ground even where giving way would cost you nothing. Put one plan up for review before you start it. For a month, keep to one rule that someone else set.
function.advise_balanced: Your ground stays firm while the load you carry matches the strength you keep for it. Keep one routine that survives a bad month. Tend one pot of herbs from spring to autumn.

candidates.cta_verdict: You would rather go the distance than win a sprint, and you tend to do your best in the second half of anything long.

catalyst.clause: the ground under you is shallow, and every load goes straight through to your knees
catalyst.remedy: Sleep and eat before you decide anything.

friction.clause: the ground packs down on itself until nothing moves across it and nothing new comes up
friction.remedy: Say yes to one deadline you did not set.

unrooted.clause: No Earth of your own under the whole structure, so every stand you take is on borrowed footing.
unrooted.remedy: Make your own footing from routine, the same bed and meals daily.

excess.clause: Ground heaped on ground past any use, a mass only Metal can shape into something useful.
excess.remedy: Spend it through Metal. Finish one exact thing today.

thin.clause: Earth kept small, a floor under you and never a wall around you.
thin.remedy: Keep it that size. Rest on it, nothing more.

friction.remedy: Even good soil is improved by weather.

mechanism_yin.base: Thick virtue carries all things, the Book of Changes says of earth: ground laid upon ground, bedrock under soil, the one element whose nature is simply to hold. Nothing reacts here. Ground settles onto ground, and the stillness deepens until whole harvests stand on it without complaint. What everything else moves through, earth remains.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the ground packs hard: so much steadiness nothing new can root, stillness sealed into immobility. Till the field. Even good soil is improved by weather.

__ore.retired_fn_body: The Core is your endurance function: the seat your strength rests on. With Earth doubled here, your constitution is bedrock: vast reserves, slow rhythms, an endurance that looks like stillness and outlasts everything that hurries. Depletion in you is geological, so gradual you rarely feel it moving. Weigh yourself honestly each season, and shore the ground before it says you must.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Earth, and here Earth stands with Earth: ground alongside ground, bedrock under soil. This is a reinforcement rather than a reaction, the part of your chart that is simply more of you. That is why Earth is your Body: your steadiness, your word, your way of staying when everything else moves. The other energies act on you. This one holds.

backlog_dips_tg_pattern.mind: Your conclusions compact like sediment until they bear weight, and nobody stampedes you off them.
backlog_dips_tg_pattern.action: You act like a season: slow to start, impossible to stop once turned.

__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Earth is your Body, and running thin, it is the steadiness under everything: digestion, sleep depth, the physical calm that lets you carry weight. Yours erodes quietly under skipped meals and moved bedtimes.

Dependable to everyone, depleted underneath. Lunch became a snack at the desk, sleep became negotiable, and the calm people rely on is being paid for out of reserves nobody sees you spending.

Stability is a practice before it is a trait. Rebuild with boring regularity: same waking hour, real lunches eaten sitting down, one slow day a week defended like an appointment. Let others see you rest so they learn to expect it.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Earth is your Body, and running over, it is heaviness accumulating: routines hardened into ruts, comfort eaten past comfort, a body built for staying that now resists moving.

Settled, comfortable, slowly cementing. The same chair, the same orders, the same weekend shape for three years running, and a low hum of dullness that gets read as contentment because it holds still.

Steadiness needs motion the way ground needs rain. Walk daily at the same hour until it is simply weather. Change one fixed habit each season purely to prove you can. Say yes to one invitation a month that mildly inconveniences you.
